info.name: Twilio SendGrid Provisioning Account Segmenting Contacts V2 API

params.name: ids
params.description: A list of segment IDs to retrieve. When this parameter is included, the `no_parent_list_ids` and `parent_list_ids` parameters are ignored and only segments with given IDs are returned.

params.name: parent_list_ids
params.description: A comma separated list up to 50 in size, to filter segments on.  Only segments that have any of these list ids as the parent list will be retrieved. This is different from the parameter of the same name used when creating a segment.

params.name: no_parent_list_id
params.description: If set to `true`, segments with an empty value of `parent_list_id` will be returned in the filter.  If the value is not present, it defaults to 'false'.

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of segments.**

The query param `parent_list_ids` is treated as a filter.  Any match will be returned.  Zero matches will return a response code of 200 with an empty `results` array.

`parent_list_ids` | `no_parent_list_id` | `ids` | `result`
-----------------:|:--------------------:|:-------------:|:-------------:
empty | false | empty | all segments values
list_ids | false | empty | segments filtered by list_ids values
list_ids |true | empty | segm
Segment `name` has to be unique. A user can not create a new segment with an existing segment name.

params.name: contacts_sample
params.description: Defaults to `true`. Set to `false` to exclude the contacts_sample in the response.
